messages:
nina: Heads-up: contractor pen-test on 2025-12-02 14:00-18:00 UTC. Scope includes RBAC deltas, KMS integration points, and audit log retention checks. Need a lightweight playbook + attestation artifact template. Pls review.
oliver: Thx. Proposed RBAC freeze 13:30-18:30 UTC. Exemptions via #sec-exceptions and require sec-approver signoff. Safelist: ci-main, observability-agent, deploy-canary. No policy changes during window.
sam: For evidence bundles: prefer separated artifacts per domain (rbac.tgz, kms.tgz, logs.tgz) with top-level attestation.pdf and manifest.sha256. Manifest should list exporter, export time, and checksum.
rebecca: Oncall: I'll run canaries 30m before and after. If canaries fail post-freeze, do not rollback until infra-eng confirms.
nina: Attestation template (short):
"""
Attestation: Pen-test 2025-12-02
Prepared by: <sec-lead>
Access granted to assessors: read-only metadata for KMS, role/permission listings, CloudTrail exports (redacted)
Denied: any Decrypt/Encrypt/GenerateDataKey operations, secret material exposures
Notes: safelisted service accounts kept active, CI excluded from freeze
"""

sam: Retest policy suggestion: critical-high fixes get prioritized retest within 72h; medium within 7 days; low on next sprint. Critical fixes need regression eval on token flows and KMS wrappers before sign-off.
oliver: KMS proxy sample policy for auditors (example):
```
{
  \"Version\": \"2012-10-17\",
  \"Statement\": [
    { \"Effect\": \"Allow\", \"Action\": [\"kms:DescribeKey\", \"kms:GetKeyRotationStatus\", \"kms:GetPublicKey\", \"kms:ListKeys\"], \"Resource\": \"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/*\" },
    { \"Effect\": \"Deny\", \"Action\": [\"kms:Decrypt\", \"kms:Encrypt\", \"kms:GenerateDataKey*\"], \"Resource\": \"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/*\" }
  ]
}
```

oliver: We'll also attach a small sample script for auditors: `aws kms list-keys --profile pt-readonly && aws kms describe-key --key-id <id>`
nina: Evidence upload location: `s3://pt-evidence/2025-12/<vendor>/`. Tag objects with `pen-test:2025-12` and `sensitivity:low|pii` as needed. Presigned links only, push to Readroom.
sam: Remediation tracking: create epic PT-2025-12 in vuln-tracker and label tickets with `pt-2025-12,evidence:attached`. Require squad owner and ETA on each ticket.
pt-bot: Epic PT-2025-12 created (https://vuln.redwood.local/epic/PT-2025-12). Tentative retest window scheduled 2025-12-04 14:00-18:00 UTC.
rebecca: I'll dry-run the evidence export today and post the manifest sample.
nina: Final: approver for lifting RBAC freeze = sec-lead or infra-director. Approver must post `RBAC_FREEZE_LIFTED` and confirm canaries green. No other signals accepted.
oliver: prepping freeze script and safelist patch.
sam: I'll prepare attestation.pdf template and upload to Readroom.
rebecca: ack
oliver: ack
nina: ack
